mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_EXPORT_TASK ( TASK_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_TYPE, EXPORT_FORMAT, QUERY_CONDITION, TOTAL_RECORDS, PROCESSED_RECORDS, STATUS, PROGRESS_PERCENT, START_TIME, END_TIME, DURATION, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, DOWNLOAD_URL, ERROR_MESSAGE, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR, EXPORT_CONFIG, BATCH_SIZE, CURRENT_BATCH, TOTAL_BATCHES, PARALLELISM, TEMP_PATH, COMPRESSED_SIZE, DOWNLOAD_COUNT, LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, EXPIRE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{exportFormat}, #{queryCondition}, #{totalRecords}, #{processedRecords}, #{status}, #{progressPercent}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{duration}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{downloadUrl}, #{errorMessage}, CAST(#{bookId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{tenantId} AS NUMBER), #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{creator}, #{exportConfig}, #{batchSize}, #{currentBatch}, #{totalBatches}, #{parallelism}, #{tempPath}, #{compressedSize}, #{downloadCount}, #{lastDownloadTime}, #{expireTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_TYPE, EXPORT_FORMAT, QUERY_CONDITION, TOTAL_RECORDS, PROCESSED_RECORDS, STATUS, PROGRESS_PERCENT, START_TIME, END_TIME, DURATION, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, DOWNLOAD_URL, ERROR_MESSAGE, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER, EXPORT_CONFIG, BATCH_SIZE, CURRENT_BATCH, TOTAL_BATCHES, PARALLELISM, TEMP_PATH, COMPRESSED_SIZE, DOWNLOAD_COUNT, LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, EXPIRE_TIME FROM T_EXPORT_TASK WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE T_EXPORT_TASK SET TASK_NAME = #{taskName}, TOTAL_RECORDS = #{totalRecords}, PROCESSED_RECORDS = #{processedRecords}, STATUS = #{status}, PROGRESS_PERCENT = #{progressPercent}, START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, DURATION = #{duration}, FILE_PATH = #{filePath}, FILE_NAME = #{fileName}, FILE_SIZE = #{fileSize}, DOWNLOAD_URL = #{downloadUrl}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updater}, EXPORT_CONFIG = #{exportConfig}, BATCH_SIZE = #{batchSize}, CURRENT_BATCH = #{currentBatch}, TOTAL_BATCHES = #{totalBatches}, PARALLELISM = #{parallelism}, TEMP_PATH = #{tempPath}, COMPRESSED_SIZE = #{compressedSize}, DOWNLOAD_COUNT = #{downloadCount}, LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME = #{lastDownloadTime} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND VERSION = #{version}
UPDATE T_EXPORT_TASK SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND CREATE_TIME < #{expireDate}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as runningTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelledTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 2 THEN PROCESSED_RECORDS ELSE 0 END) as totalExportedRecords, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 2 THEN FILE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) as totalFileSize, AVG(CASE WHEN STATUS = 2 AND DURATION > 0 THEN DURATION ELSE NULL END) as avgDuration, MAX(CASE WHEN STATUS = 2 AND PROCESSED_RECORDS > 0 THEN PROCESSED_RECORDS ELSE NULL END) as maxRecords, SUM(DOWNLOAD_COUNT) as totalDownloads FROM T_EXPORT_TASK WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= #{param.startDate}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 0
AND a.ALLOCATION_PERIOD = #{param.allocationPeriod}
AND a.ALLOCATION_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{param.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.ALLOCATION_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{param.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND a.BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)

SELECT a.ALLOCATION_ID as allocationId, a.ALLOCATION_NO as allocationNo, a.ALLOCATION_PERIOD as allocationPeriod, a.SOURCE_CENTER_ID as sourceCenterId, sc.CENTER_NAME as sourceCenterName, a.ALLOCATION_METHOD as allocationMethod, a.TOTAL_AMOUNT as totalAmount, a.ALLOCATION_STATUS as allocationStatus, a.ALLOCATION_DATE as allocationDate, a.IS_GENERATE_VOUCHER as isGenerateVoucher, a.VOUCHER_ID as voucherId, a.REMARK as remark, a.CREATE_TIME as createTime, a.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, a.CREATOR as creator FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION a LEFT JOIN T_COST_CENTER sc ON a.SOURCE_CENTER_ID = sc.CENTER_ID AND sc.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 0
AND a.ALLOCATION_PERIOD = #{param.allocationPeriod}
AND a.ALLOCATION_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{param.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.ALLOCATION_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{param.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND a.BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)
ORDER BY a.ALLOCATION_DATE DESC, a.ALLOCATION_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve WHERE ve.IS_DELETED = 0
AND ve.VOUCHER_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{param.voucherDateStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ve.VOUCHER_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{param.voucherDateEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ve.BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)

SELECT ve.ENTRY_ID as entryId, ve.VOUCHER_ID as voucherId, ve.ENTRY_NO as entryNo, ve.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, ve.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT as debitAmount, ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT as creditAmount, ve.CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, ve.EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, ve.AUXILIARY_INFO as auxiliaryInfo, ve.VOUCHER_DATE as voucherDate, ve.REMARK as remark, ve.CREATE_TIME as createTime, ve.CREATOR as creator FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve WHERE ve.IS_DELETED = 0
AND ve.VOUCHER_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{param.voucherDateStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ve.VOUCHER_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{param.voucherDateEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ve.BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)
ORDER BY ve.VOUCHER_DATE DESC, ve.VOUCHER_ID DESC, ve.ENTRY_NO ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE T_EXPORT_TASK SET PROCESSED_RECORDS = #{processedRecords}, PROGRESS_PERCENT = #{progressPercent}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}

UPDATE T_EXPORT_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE TASK_ID IN
#{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_TYPE, EXPORT_FORMAT, STATUS, PROGRESS_PERCENT, START_TIME, PROCESSED_RECORDS, TOTAL_RECORDS FROM T_EXPORT_TASK WHERE STATUS = 1 AND IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT LOG_ID as logId, TASK_ID as taskId, LOG_LEVEL as logLevel, LOG_MESSAGE as logMessage, CREATE_TIME as createTime FROM T_EXPORT_LOG WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_EXPORT_LOG ( LOG_ID, TASK_ID, LOG_LEVEL, LOG_MESSAGE, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_EXPORT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{param.taskId}, #{param.logLevel}, #{param.logMessage}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT CONFIG_KEY as configKey, CONFIG_VALUE as configValue FROM T_SYSTEM_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_TYPE = 'FILE_STORAGE'
